import csv
import io
from decimal import Decimal
from api import order_summary
from csv_export import render_order

for order, expected_total in [
    ({'id': 42, 'total': Decimal('12.5'), 'currency': 'USD'}, '12.50'),
    ({'id': 'order,\"quoted\"\\nsecond line', 'total': Decimal('1234.567'), 'currency': 'cur,\"quoted\"\\nline'}, '1234.57'),
    ({'id': 0, 'total': Decimal('0'), 'currency': 'JPY'}, '0.00'),
]:
    assert order_summary(order) == {'id': order['id'], 'total': expected_total, 'currency': order['currency']}
    output = render_order(order)
    assert output.startswith('id,total,currency\\r\\n')
    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(output))) == [
        ['id', 'total', 'currency'],
        [str(order['id']), expected_total, order['currency']],
    ]
print('Passed: API fields, CSV header and single order row, decimal formatting, CSV escaping (3 cases).')
